title: Comic-Con is on in San Diego!
description:
Costumes, creativity, and nonstop energy! 🦸💥 Comic‑Con is happening now in San Diego and will continue through 2030. More than 135,000 attendees are expected during the convention.  

People from all over the world come here to be part of this world's premier pop culture convention, and you never know who you're going to meet. Have a great time out there!

More info: insidesandiego.org/comic-con-will-remain-san-diego-through-2030
